## The problem you are trying to solve

Describe the situation that makes you want this feature. Often this is a gap in the curriculum, a workflow that is awkward, or a behavior that surprises new users. Focus on the problem rather than the solution.

## The solution you have in mind

What you would build. Be as specific as you can. Sketches and screenshots help.

## Alternatives you considered

Other approaches that came up, and why you set them aside.

## Additional context

Links to related issues, prior art in other tools, anything else.

## Out-of-scope check

The project README and `CONTRIBUTING.md` list a few things that are explicitly out of scope (a backend, a CMS, translations for now). If your request touches one of those, say a sentence on why it is worth reopening the question.
